part.text:
We have a web game in index.html that has been built incrementally. However, the user says "All implementation tasks completed, but the final full validation just failed. The page was loaded in a real browser and one or more checks did not pass. Validation errors: - index.html:

text does not match meta.json description" Thus we need to edit index.html so that the paragraph's text matches meta.json description exactly (including whitespace, punctuation, and lines). The meta.json description appears to be: "The dot auto‑scrolls horizontally while a constant gravity pulls it down; each tap gives a short upward thrust, letting you steer through vertical gaps in a scrolling pipe." Now the index.html currently has a description in

line 21: "The dot auto‑scrolls horizontally while gravity pulls it down; each tap gives a short upward thrust, letting you steer through vertical gaps in a scrolling pipe." Yes I need to adapt it to match meta.json. Specifically change in index.html line 21: currently it is: "The dot auto‑scrolls horizontally while gravity pulls it down; each tap gives a short upward thrust, letting you steer through vertical gaps in a scrolling pipe." But meta.json says "while a constant gravity pulls it down". So we need to add "a constant" before "gravity". Also add perhaps a hyphen or some punctuation; both have hyphen between auto‑scrolls but uses en dash? It's using the same "auto‑scrolls" (non-breaking hyphen). So we need to overwrite the description to match exactly. Thus edit index.html's p.game-description. Search in index.html.

input.oldString: The dot auto‑scrolls horizontally while gravity pulls it down; each tap gives a short upward thrust, letting you steer through vertical gaps in a scrolling pipe.
input.newString: The dot auto‑scrolls horizontally while a constant gravity pulls it down; each tap gives a short upward thrust, letting you steer through vertical gaps in a scrolling pipe.
